Install and setup @moul-dev/ui in your project.

## Package Installation

Add the `@moul-dev/ui` package to your workspace using your preferred package manager:

```bash
bun add @moul-dev/ui
# or
npm install @moul-dev/ui
# or
pnpm add @moul-dev/ui
# or
yarn add @moul-dev/ui
```

## Setup & Registration

### Option 1: Global Import

To register all `<moul-*>` custom elements globally in your app entrypoint:

```typescript
import '@moul-dev/ui'
```

### Option 2: Individual Component Imports

For granular or tree-shaken imports, you can import only the specific components you use:

```typescript
import '@moul-dev/ui/button'
import '@moul-dev/ui/modal'
import '@moul-dev/ui/card'
```

## Basic Usage

Once imported, components can be used anywhere in your HTML or templates:

```html
<moul-button variant="primary">Click Me</moul-button>
```

Moul UI is a modular Web Component library designed for product engineers who want a modern, consistent, and highly accessible baseline for web applications across any framework.

By merging the lightweight reactivity and encapsulation of **Lit** with the rich responsive design system of **Bootstrap 6** inside **Shadow DOM**, Moul UI delivers complete style isolation with zero runtime CSS-in-JS overhead.

## Key Features

- **Universal Web Components**: Works natively in HTML, React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Astro, and Solid with standard custom element markup (`<moul-button>`, `<moul-modal>`, etc.).
- **Complete Style Encapsulation**: Bootstrap 6 styles are adopted into each element's shadow root via constructable stylesheets (`CSSStyleSheet`). No style leakage into or out of your components.
- **WAI-ARIA Compliant**: Built with comprehensive keyboard navigation, focus trap management, floating positioning, and screen reader announcements.
- **Customizable Theming**: Dynamically theme components using CSS Custom Properties (`--moul-brand-hue`, `--moul-brand-radius-factor`, etc.).

### 1. Element Tag Convention
All components use the `moul-` prefix:
```html
<moul-button variant="primary">Submit</moul-button>
```

Buttons and interactive elements dispatch composed custom events:
```html
<moul-button id="btn" variant="primary">Click</moul-button>
<script>
  document.getElementById('btn').addEventListener('moul-press', (e) => {
    console.log('Pressed');
```

```html
<moul-button variant="ghost" is-icon aria-label="Delete item">
  <svg slot="icon-start"><use href="#trash"/></svg>
</moul-button>
```

Custom branding is configured via CSS custom properties on `:root`:
```css
:root {
  --moul-brand-hue: 250;
  --moul-brand-radius-factor: 1.0;
  --moul-brand-density-factor: 1.0;
}
```
